name: Conifer
long_description: AI now runs on a market of hundreds of models and providers that changes constantly, each with its own price, strengths and failure modes. Agents also act faster, and on more information, than people can meaningfully review. Conifer builds the decision layer between agents and the people in charge. Our gateway puts 240+ models from 28 providers behind one key, with 99.99% uptime. Our router picks a model for each request by weighing the task against its cost, and Parallax reviews the code agents write.
one_liner: Intelligent decisions for critical AI operations
